 In 2008, Celine Dion bought a lot on Florida's Jupiter Island for $7 million; her water park mansion there sold 9 years later for $28 million
 Geca Flores 2026년 10월 23일 금 오전 4:20 UTC 0 Celine Dion’s real estate portfolio showcases ultra-luxurious properties, including her oceanfront estate on Florida’s Jupiter Island, which she and her late husband, René Angélil, expanded in 2008 by purchasing an adjacent lot for $7 million. The couple had purchased the original property in 2005 for $12.5 million. After several years, the iconic singer made a huge splash by selling it for $28 million.
 Following the French-Canadian hitmaker’s massive Taking Chances World Tour in the same year, the couple continued developing their expansive Florida property in one of the state’s exclusive residential communities, which is also home to a number of celebrities.
 Two years after the acquisition, they completed construction of the estate.
 Dion opted for a custom-built, Bahamian-inspired estate that included a custom water park.
 Celine Dion performs at Allianz Riviera Stadium on July 20, 2017 in Nice, France. Toni Anne Barson/Getty Images The couple had always dreamed of owning an enormous estate where they could welcome their big extended family, as reported on Oprah’s website. 
 According to the singer, she feels happiest when her home is filled with family, sometimes welcoming 30 or more relatives.
 Dion’s Jupiter Island estate featured a nearly 10,000-square-foot main house with five side pavilions, including several guest houses, a tennis house that doubles as a basketball court, a simulated golf range, a beach house with a sleeping loft and a water park.
 These amenities allowed their guests to enjoy a variety of activities in the couple’s private backyard.
 “That space, that lot, that beach, those pools are [for] when we get together as a family, everybody can have a grandiose time with each other,” the “My Heart Will Go On” hitmaker told the publication, adding, “Everybody can soak in.”
 Advertisement
 Moreover, the Florida estate had a personal touch, as the Grammy winner’s son designed a tree house with a slide.
 When discussing her water park mansion, the 58-year-old icon revealed that she drew inspiration from magazines when designing her dream home.
 “I buy a lot of magazines,” Dion shared. “And I have a lot of dream files [of] … the best jewelry, the best homes, best babies, whatever.”
 After nine years, Dion sold the spectacular Florida estate for $28 million in 2017.
 Initially listed for $72 million in 2013, the property was among the most expensive listings in the state. However, it ultimately sold for far less than its original asking price.
 According to Joseph Montanaro, the broker for Dion’s Montreal property, the singer was selling her Florida estate, which had served as her home base before moving to Las Vegas, because “she’s not in Florida much anymore either,” according to CNBC. 
 Moreover, the sale came about a year after Dion’s husband passed away on January 14, 2016, at the age of 73, at their Las Vegas home after a long battle with throat cancer.
